opening.argument: The material directs viewers to fund a contract with ETH and presents larger liquidity as producing larger profits. It states, "You need to deposit at least 0.1 for the contract to execute correctly and complete the flash loan uniswap bot" and that "The higher the liquidity, the higher the profit." It further instructs viewers to send liquidity from a wallet to new contract code, connect through Injected Web3, and confirm gas fees to execute what it calls a flash loan attack. The promised result is that "any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes." These are concrete instructions tied to purported trading-bot returns. The displayed deployment, wallet activity, and balances do not establish the contract's behavior, destination ownership, causation, or that the displayed balance represents a completed return.

citations.quote: You need to deposit at least 0.1 for the contract to execute correctly and complete the flash loan uniswap bot.
The higher the liquidity, the higher the profit.
Go to your metamask or any wallet and send the liquidity to the new contract code.
click the red Action button and confirm the gas fees to execute the flash loan attack
any profit will be returned to your wallet in a few seconds/minutes
